xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Directorate General of Goods and Services Tax Intelligence, Bengaluru Zonal Unit
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
The show cause notice is with respect to classification of certain Namkeen products sold under the brand name ‘Bingo!’ during the period July 2017 to February 2024. While the Company classified these products as “Namkeens and similar edible preparations” under HSN 21069099 with GST @ 12%, the Department contended that such products should be classified as “extruded or expanded products” under HSN 19059030 with GST @ 18%.
The notice required the Company to show cause as to why (i) differential duty of ~ Rs. 591.56 crores, and (ii) interest and penalty thereon, should not be payable by the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Upon filing of writ petition by the Company, the High Court of Karnataka has stayed all the proceedings pursuant to the show cause notice until further orders.
